findings.issue: Reaction routes have no workspace/channel membership check — any authenticated user can access any message's reactions cross-tenant
findings.impact: Cross-tenant data access: User A can add/remove reactions on any message in any workspace without membership
findings.fix: Add requireChannelAccess middleware to all reaction routes

findings.issue: SECURITY DEFINER functions (handle_new_user, handle_new_channel, handle_new_workspace) missing SET search_path
findings.impact: Search_path injection: user with CREATE privilege can hijack these functions for privilege escalation
findings.fix: Add SET search_path = 'public' to all SECURITY DEFINER function definitions

findings.issue: Message search uses getSupabase() (anon client) instead of req.supabase (JWT client) — auth.uid() is NULL
findings.impact: search_messages RPC cannot verify workspace membership; cross-tenant message content leak
findings.fix: Replace getSupabase() with req.supabase on messages/routes.ts line 38

findings.issue: No per-event Socket.io authorization — any connected client can join any channel room via channel:join
findings.impact: Socket-based tenant isolation bypass: attacker can listen to any channel's real-time events
findings.fix: Add membership check in channel:join handler before adding socket to room

findings.issue: Zero E2E test coverage for any critical user flow — all 48 comprehensive E2E tests are skipped/test.skip
findings.impact: No automated regression detection for any user journey; every deploy blind
findings.fix: Build auth, workspace, and messaging E2E tests as Tier 0 smoke tests running on every PR

findings.issue: TypeScript types severely out of sync with DB schema — 6 interfaces vs 16 tables; soft-delete fields missing
findings.impact: Type safety gaps across codebase; developers forced to use 'any' for many operations
findings.fix: Regenerate types via supabase gen types typescript; add CI drift check

findings.issue: Workspace member management lacks admin/owner role check — any workspace member can add/remove/change roles
findings.impact: Privilege escalation: member can self-promote to admin or remove other members
findings.fix: Add admin/owner role verification in member management routes

findings.issue: Socket.io allowEIO3: true enables Engine.IO v3 legacy protocol with known vulnerabilities
findings.impact: Expanded attack surface on real-time transport layer
findings.fix: Set allowEIO3: false unless backward compatibility is required

findings.issue: Same SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF used for both dev and prod — no separate Supabase project per environment
findings.impact: Migrations from develop branch directly affect the same database as main
findings.fix: Use separate Supabase projects with separate project ref secrets per environment

findings.issue: k6 load tests only hit / and /healthz — no real endpoints tested; not integrated into CI
findings.impact: Load tests provide zero insight into actual system performance under load
findings.fix: Add meaningful k6 test scenarios for message send, search, and WebSocket connect; run in CI

findings.issue: No tablet-specific breakpoint — layout jumps from 3-column desktop to single-column mobile at 768px
findings.impact: Tablet users receive suboptimal layout; no progressive collapse
findings.fix: Add 1024px breakpoint with collapsed sidebar drawer pattern

findings.issue: No production approval gate — push to main immediately deploys without manual review
findings.impact: Any merge to main can deploy to production with zero human oversight
findings.fix: Add environment: production with required reviewers to deploy job

findings.issue: governance.yml and platform.yml workflows are broken — reference 5 nonexistent scripts (full_engine.ps1, auto_fix.ps1, etc.)
findings.impact: CI noise on every push; no actual governance enforcement
findings.fix: Fix or disable broken workflows; consolidate into working evaluate_gate.py invocations

findings.issue: Worker package (apps/worker/) has no test script, no health endpoint, no observability — completely unmonitored
findings.impact: Worker failures invisible until users report symptoms
findings.fix: Add vitest config, health endpoint, and basic logging/metrics to worker package

findings.issue: Prod Caddyfile only has /health route; dev Caddyfile has /healthz and /health* and API subdomain — inconsistency
findings.impact: Health check path ambiguity between environments could cause deploy failures
findings.fix: Standardize health endpoints across both Caddyfiles; match Docker HEALTHCHECK paths

findings.issue: Channel slug dedup loop has no max-attempt safety guard unlike workspace MAX_ATTEMPTS=100
findings.impact: Infinite loop on slug collision; potential DoS vector
findings.fix: Add MAX_ATTEMPTS=100 guard to channel slug dedup

findings.issue: All pages use 'use client' — no React Server Components; no route-level code splitting
findings.impact: Full JS bundle on every page; no streaming SSR benefit
findings.fix: Convert non-interactive sections to server components; use next/dynamic for heavy components

findings.issue: No mobile bottom navigation bar — every context switch requires opening sidebar
findings.impact: Mobile navigation requires 3+ taps; poor one-handed UX
findings.fix: Add mobile bottom tab bar with workspace, channels, notifications, search, user menu

findings.issue: docker system prune -af --volumes destroys previous SHA-tagged images before health check succeeds
findings.impact: If deploy fails, previous rollback target images are already deleted
findings.fix: Move prune to after successful health check

findings.issue: No shared API contract types between frontend and backend — types are manually duplicated
findings.impact: Frontend/backend contract drift causes silent production failures
findings.fix: Create packages/contract/ with shared API request/response types

findings.issue: Unicode/emoji characters used as icons throughout — no icon library
findings.impact: Inconsistent cross-platform rendering; no accessibility support for icons
findings.fix: Migrate to lucide-react SVG icons with aria-hidden and aria-label

findings.issue: DigitalOcean alerts (CPU>80%, Memory>80%) only go to email — no Slack, PagerDuty, or SMS
findings.impact: Critical infrastructure alerts may go unnoticed
findings.fix: Add Slack webhook integration to DO monitoring alert channel

findings.issue: No keyboard shortcut help documentation — users cannot discover keyboard shortcuts
findings.impact: Productivity features go unused
findings.fix: Add keyboard shortcut reference in settings; add Ctrl+/ help overlay
